description: This file defines the NodeApp class, which extends Android's Application class. It manages a singleton instance of NodeRuntime, initializes strict mode policies during app startup in debug mode, and provides accessors to the runtime and preferences.

classes.name: NodeApp
classes.description: Custom Application class that manages the lifecycle and singleton instance of NodeRuntime, and configures debug policies.

methods.name: ensureRuntime
methods.description: Returns the singleton NodeRuntime instance, creating it if necessary, in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: peekRuntime
methods.description: Provides access to the currently existing NodeRuntime instance without creating it.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the application, setting strict mode policies if in debug mode.
